newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slightly lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slightly lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly lower on Wednesday, brought down by weakness in some financial and property-related issues, brokers said.
They said the Nikkei average was seeing selling pressure just above the key 18,000 level.
At 0014 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was down 36.50 points or 0.20 percent at 17,985.20. Its June futures stood 50 points lower at 17,990.
